recognize_zh: 周邊血中有數個比小淋巴球大兩倍左右的芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、可見核仁，細胞質少而淡藍、無顆粒也無 Auer 小體；形態無系別特徵，需流式細胞儀判定為 AML 微分化型。
features: Medium to large blasts (about two times a small lymphocyte) with high N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Small mature lymphocyte present for size comparison
Many red cells contain small dark dots, likely stain precipitate or artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not identified. A small mature lymphocyte is present for comparison. Small dark dots overlying many red cells are most likely stain precipitate. Findings are consistent with circulating blasts of acute leukemia; lineage cannot be determined morphologically, and flow cytometry is needed to support AML with minimal differentiation.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts can be morphologically identical and are distinguished by expression of B- or T-lineage markers on flow cytometry.
In AML without maturation at least 3% of blasts are MPO or Sudan black B positive, whereas AML-M0 blasts are below 3%.

ddx.dx: Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Blastoid MCL cells are CD5+, cyclin D1+ mature B cells lacking CD34 and TdT.
